name: Softlock stub: the screen sum and the self-decrypt
summary: The clear head of the code a Softlock BASIC enters through VARS: it sums the screen $4000-$5BFF as 3584 big-endian words and decrypts its own tail from +$3D with that key (XOR with the key byte, plus the previous decrypted byte, the key counting up), stopping on the first pair whose second byte is $48. The tail then copies LD-BYTES from the ROM and patches it into the turbo loader.

entries.name: Stub
entries.summary: sum the screen, decrypt the tail, fall into it

notes: The BASIC of the tape carries "SOFTLOCKtm 1984"; Elite (Firebird 1985) is the only Softlock tape reversed here, so the key constants (the screen key, IY = $2E6D, the range) are this tape's.
